name: Reliquary Guardian
languages: speaks and understands the languages of its creator

traits.name: Divine Blessing
traits.text:
The reliquary guardian deals an additional 14 (4d6)
damage with its weapon attacks, included below. This damage is either
radiant, if lawfully aligned, or necrotic, if chaotically aligned.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text:
The reliquary guardian is immune to any spell or
effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The reliquary guardian’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: * At will: chill touch (17th level, if chaotically aligned), protection from evil and good, sacred flame (17th level, if lawfully aligned) * 3/day each: lightning bolt, flame strike (deals necrotic instead of radiant if chaotically aligned), spirit guardians, spiritual weapon * 1/day each: commune, dispel evil and good, dispel magic

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The reliquary guardian has advantage on saving
throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: The reliquary guardian’s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The reliquary guardian makes two attacks with either its
greatsword or its slam attack.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target.
Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage and 14 (4d6) necrotic or radiant damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22
(4d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and 14 (4d6) necrotic or radiant damage.

actions.name: Pronouncement (1/day)
actions.text:
All creatures within 120 feet of the reliquary
guardian that can hear it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed saving throw, the target takes 66 (12d10) thunder damage and
is stunned for 1 minute. On a successful saving throw, the target takes half
damage and is not stunned. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw
at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
